title: microsoft/data-formulator: AI-assisted data exploration and visualisation
friendlyTitle: Microsoft Data Formulator helps turn data questions into charts
summary: Microsoft’s Data Formulator is an interactive system for connecting, transforming, exploring and visualising data with AI assistance. The MIT-licensed project has roughly 17,400 stars and was among the day’s strongest AI-related GitHub Trending entries.
friendlySummary: This open-source tool uses AI to help people explore data, reshape it and create visualisations. It has about 17,400 GitHub stars.
whyItMatters: Analysts can use it to move from a question to a transformed dataset and chart while keeping the intermediate data work visible. It is a practical option for prototyping analysis before translating the workflow into a governed production pipeline.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Try it when you need to understand a dataset or quickly test a chart idea. Keep the steps visible so you can check that the AI changed the data correctly.
